title: Juicy Buttery Norwegian Morcilla Pasta
description: A midnight craving Norwegian dish featuring morcilla in a buttery and creamy sauce, with a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the morcilla to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the morcilla from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the olive oil, garlic, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the heavy cream to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the cream sauce by half, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet and toss with the cream sauce.
Slice the cooked morcilla and add to the pasta, tossing to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
